proposal.hypothesis: The independent option calculations can be distributed with a static OpenMP outer loop, while num_threads(threads) caps the requested team at the passed budget. A serial path for one thread and fewer than 512 options per requested thread should avoid paying parallel-region overhead on small workloads. Each loop iteration writes exactly its own result index; the controller still needs to verify correctness and measure the tradeoff.

retained: Extracted the per-option Black-Scholes expression into an inline helper used by both execution paths.
Added an OpenMP outer loop with schedule(static) and num_threads(threads), assigning each iteration a unique output element.
Retained a serial path for nonpositive work, one or fewer threads, and fewer than 512 options per requested thread.
